head: codex/5717-podcast-studio-copy
title: [v0.91.8][podcast][ui] Update Synthetic Minds podcast studio copy
body:
Closes #5717

Updates the integrated podcast studio page on top of #5715 with the operator-requested launch copy and link fixes: supplied Agent Logic SVG logo, Synthetic Minds Podcast naming, blue Minds treatment, proposed episodes 1-10, no-video FAQ truth, email contact button, RSS subscribe link, and no bare footer email address.

Validation: podcast launch packet validator PASS, test_podcast_launch_packet PASS, deterministic studio copy/link contract PASS, git diff --check PASS, and typed C-SDLC doctor PASS. Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview reviewed exact implementation commit 64b747a9c and returned CLEAN with only the deployment-layout residual that ../feed.xml and ../audio/meet-the-ai-coworkers.wav must remain valid.
